observed_behavior: SC 2.4.5 Level AA requires more than one way to locate a web page within a set of web pages, except where it results from or is a step in a process.
context: Normative WCAG 2.2 Recommendation, 12 Dec 2024; criterion level/exception preserved
limitations: No requirement for three simultaneous menus, mandatory search, or multiple ways on process steps.
notes: SC text authority only; no site accessibility testing
